name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

builds.name: nxnative
builds.about: Upstream nxnative with switch2mac's overlay and key-2 settings: nxnative's own Ocarina of Time profile, kept up to date with its main branch.

builds.name: kid-with-sword-remake
builds.about: cheemu21's nxnative port of this game (MIT): Ocarina fixes merged ahead of upstream, fewer render-pass splits, a 30 / 60 fps frame step, MetalFX upscaling. Its author reports 60 fps at 720p on a MacBook Air M5; recommended for MacBook Air.

choose.why: MacBook Air: cheemu21's port was made and tested on one (60 fps at 720p on an M5 Air)
16 GB or less: cheemu21's port was made on a 16 GB Mac and releases texture memory (about 7.5 GB in Kokiri Forest)
Other Macs: nxnative's own Ocarina of Time build
